# VeilPay

> Invoicing and payments on Solana, built to actually land. VeilPay lets freelancers
> generate an invoice, get paid in USDC directly to their wallet, and rely on the
> Smart TX Stack (dynamic Jito tips + a Groq AI retry agent) to get that payment
> confirmed even when the network is congested.

VeilPay is non-custodial: it never holds, custodies, or has access to user funds.
Every payment happens wallet-to-wallet, approved directly by the payer via Phantom.
Amounts and wallet addresses are visible on Solana's public ledger, the same as any
standard on-chain transfer. VeilPay's value is reliability (a payment built to
land), not privacy.

## Core features

- Invoice creation and a shareable pay link (pay.html)
- Direct SPL USDC transfers submitted as Jito bundles via the Smart TX Stack
- AI-assisted retry logic (Groq) that decides whether/how to retry a stalled
  or failed transaction, with safeguards against double-charging a payer
- Token swaps (SOL/USDC/USDT) with live Jupiter quotes
- Buy USDC with naira, or cash out USDC to a Nigerian bank/Opay account, via Bitnob
- Recurring/subscription invoices
- Wallet risk scanner for flagging new or suspicious wallets before paying

## Key pages

- Home: https://veilpay.store/
- Dashboard (invoices, swap, buy/cash out): https://veilpay.store/dashboard.html
- Pay an invoice: https://veilpay.store/pay.html
- Privacy Policy: https://veilpay.store/privacy.html
